title: Mind the RefGAP: Correcting Reference Attention in Diffusion-Based Visual Editing
title_zh: 矫正参考注意力的 RefGAP 方法提升扩散基础视觉编辑中的身份 fidelity

paragraphs.en: Reference-guided diffusion editors struggle to faithfully reproduce user-provided references. We identify a potential bottleneck in diffusion editors: many methods provide limited reference-attention allocation. For example, in LoomVideo, edit-region queries assign less than 1 % 1\% of their attention mass to the reference. We introduce RefGAP, a training-free correction that determines logit-offset magnitudes online at each layer from the reference-attention mass measured during the forward pass. Positive offsets to reference logits strengthen reference usage by edit-region queries, while negative offsets for keep-region queries limit reference-induced changes outside the edit. Two global coefficients control the correction; they are selected once on validation data from four development diffusion editors and held fixed. Across seven diffusion-based image/video editors, RefGAP improves identity fidelity in head swapping and face swapping. RefGAP achieves a fidelity-preservation trade-off comparable to separately tuned constant edit-side biases, without per-approach strength sweeps. Additional experiments on virtual try-on and background replacement evaluate transfer beyond identity editing.
paragraphs.zh: 参考引导式扩散编辑器难以忠实地再现用户提供的参考图像。 我们识别出扩散编辑器中一个潜在的瓶颈：许多方法对参考注意力的分配有限。 例如，在 LoomVideo 中，编辑区域查询将其注意力质量不到 1% 分配给参考图像。 我们提出了 RefGAP，一种无需训练的校正方法，它在前向传播过程中根据测得的参考注意力质量，在线确定每一层的逻辑值偏移量大小。 对参考逻辑值施加正向偏移可增强编辑区域查询对参考图像的使用，而对保留区域查询施加负向偏移则可限制参考图像在编辑区域外引起的变化。 两个全局系数用于控制校正；这些系数仅在验证数据上基于四个开发用扩散编辑器选择一次，并保持固定不变。 在七种基于扩散的图像/视频编辑器中，RefGAP 提升了身份替换和面部替换中的身份保真度。 RefGAP 实现了与单独调优的恒定编辑侧偏置相当的保真度保持权衡，且无需针对每种方法分别调整强度。 在虚拟试穿和背景替换上的额外实验评估了该方法在身份编辑之外的迁移能力。

paragraphs.en: Modern diffusion editors can condition on a user-provided reference image to edit a driving image or video, supporting tasks such as head swapping, face swapping, virtual try-on, and background replacement. Many recent systems adopt an in-context design ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) , in which reference tokens share the denoiser’s attention sequence with the content being edited. Yet direct access to the reference does not guarantee fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 现代扩散编辑器可以根据用户提供的参考图像对驱动图像或视频进行条件编辑，支持换头、换脸、虚拟试穿和背景替换等任务。 许多近期的系统采用了上下文内设计（Jiang 等人，2025；Wu 等人，2025a；Wu 等人，2025b；Black Forest Labs，2025），其中参考标记与正在编辑的内容共享去噪器的注意力序列。 然而，直接访问参考图像并不一定能保证结果的准确性。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods strengthen reference conditioning through task-specific training ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2024 ) or training-free manipulation of reference attention or features ( Shin et al., 2025 ; Fan et al., 2024 ) . However, inference-time interventions typically rely on fixed, empirically chosen coefficients that may require retuning across models or tasks. They do not explicitly couple reference-attention enhancement in edit regions with suppression in keep regions.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通过任务特定的训练（Wang 等人，2025；Chen 等人，2024；Fang 等人，2024）或对参考注意力或特征进行无需训练的调整（Shin 等人，2025；Fan 等人，2024）来强化参考条件约束。 然而，推理时的干预通常依赖于固定且通过经验选择的系数，这些系数可能需要在不同模型或任务之间重新调整。 它们并未明确地将编辑区域中参考注意力的增强与保留区域中的抑制联系起来。

paragraphs.en: We partition each attention layer’s keys into reference and rest tokens and compute the fraction ρ \rho of each query’s attention mass assigned to the reference ( fig. 2 ). Using an edit mask, we average ρ \rho separately over content queries in the edit and keep regions. The profiles reveal two patterns: some approaches exhibit substantially higher reference attention in edit versus keep regions within a localized layer band, typically in the network’s second half; others assign little reference attention to edit queries across many layers, falling below 1 % 1\% on LoomVideo ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . These patterns motivate selective layer intervention, while ρ \rho provides an online signal for correction strength.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将每个注意力层的键分为参考标记和其余标记，并计算每个查询的注意力质量中分配给参考标记的比例 ρ（图 2）。 我们使用编辑掩码，分别对编辑区域和保留区域中的内容查询计算 ρ 的平均值。 这些分布特征揭示了两种模式：某些方法在局部化的层带内，其编辑区域的参考注意力显著高于保留区域，通常出现在网络的后半部分；而其他方法则在许多层中几乎不向编辑查询分配参考注意力，在 LoomVideo 上甚至低于 1%（Wu 等人，2026）。 这些模式促使我们进行选择性层干预，而 ρ 则提供了用于调整修正强度的在线信号。

paragraphs.en: Based on this measurement, we introduce RefGAP, a training-free correction named after the reference-attention gap it aims to bridge. Within a single forward pass, using statistics already produced by the attention computation, RefGAP reads the reference-attention masses in both regions and adds one scalar to every reference-key logit: a positive offset for edit-region queries, so they read the reference more, and a negative offset for keep-region queries, so the stronger reference signal does not pull the preserved content with it. The offset adapts to the measured reference-attention mass at each intervened layer and forward pass, reducing the need for model- or task-specific tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这一测量结果，我们提出了 RefGAP——一种无需训练的校正方法，其名称源于它旨在弥合的“参考注意力差距”。 在单次前向传播中，RefGAP 利用注意力计算已生成的统计信息，读取两个区域中的参考注意力质量，并为每个参考键的 logits 添加一个标量：对编辑区域的查询施加正偏移，使其更多地读取参考信息；对保留区域的查询施加负偏移，防止更强的参考信号将保留内容一同拉入。 该偏移量会根据每个干预层和前向传播中测得的参考注意力质量进行自适应调整，从而减少模型或任务特定的调参需求。

paragraphs.en: We calibrate two global coefficients and establish a shared layer-selection rule on four development approaches (JoyAI-Video-Edit ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , LoomVideo ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , FLUX.2-klein and FLUX.2-klein-base ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) ) using 40 head-swap validation clips. We freeze the coefficients, thresholds, and rule before applying them to three held-out approaches. Each approach requires one validation profiling run to determine its layer set under the fixed rule; this set is reused across tasks without tuning. Identity similarity improves on head-swap and face-swap tasks. Without task-specific retuning, virtual try-on fidelity improves across seven approaches, while background replacement yields mixed results, including a clear degradation on Qwen-Image-Edit ( section 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 40 个头部替换验证片段，对两个全局系数进行校准，并在四种开发方法（JoyAI-Video-Edit（Xiao 等人，2026）、LoomVideo（Wu 等人，2026）、FLUX.2-klein 和 FLUX.2-klein-base（Black Forest Labs，2025））上建立共享的层选择规则。 在将其应用于三种预留方法之前，我们冻结了这些系数、阈值和规则。 每种方法都需要一次验证配置运行，以确定在固定规则下的层集合；该集合无需调整即可跨任务重复使用。 在头部替换和面部替换任务中，身份相似性得到提升。 在没有针对特定任务重新调整的情况下，虚拟试穿保真度在七种方法中均有提升，而背景替换的结果则好坏参半，包括 Qwen-Image-Edit（第 5 节）中的明显退化。

paragraphs.zh: 我们测量了编辑和保留查询的参考注意力质量，揭示了不同方法所依赖的分配模式，以及某些方法中有限的参考注意力。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate cross-approach and cross-task transfer using a single configuration calibrated once on 40 head-swap validation clips. Without retuning, it consistently boosts identity fidelity across seven approaches in head and face swapping (alongside an attribute-preservation trade-off), transfers to virtual try-on, and delineates transfer boundaries with mixed results on background replacement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用仅在 40 个头部替换验证片段上校准过一次的唯一配置，展示了跨方法和跨任务的迁移能力。 无需重新调整，该方法在头部和面部替换的七种方法中持续提升了身份识别准确性（同时存在属性保留的权衡），并成功迁移至虚拟试穿领域；但在背景替换任务中，其迁移边界则呈现出混合结果。

paragraphs.en: Reference-guided editors incorporate visual conditions either as tokens in a shared attention sequence or through a separate conditioning branch. In-context systems such as VACE ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) , LoomVideo ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , JoyAI-Video-Edit ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , Qwen-Image-Edit ( Wu et al., 2025a ) , OmniGen2 ( Wu et al., 2025b ) , and FLUX.2-klein ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) allow reference and content tokens to interact within joint attention. Decoupled methods inject reference features through cross-attention or additive branches, as in IP-Adapter ( Ye et al., 2023 ) . RefGAP targets the in-context setting, where reference and content tokens compete within the same softmax and their relative mass can be modified directly.
paragraphs.zh: 参考引导型编辑器将视觉条件以共享注意力序列中的标记形式或通过独立的条件分支进行整合。 上下文内系统（如 VACE (Jiang et al., 2025)、LoomVideo (Wu et al., 2026)、JoyAI-Video-Edit (Xiao et al., 2026)、Qwen-Image-Edit (Wu et al., 2025a)、OmniGen2 (Wu et al., 2025b) 和 FLUX.2-klein (Black Forest Labs, 2025)）允许参考标记与内容标记在联合注意力中相互作用。 解耦方法通过交叉注意力或加法分支注入参考特征，例如 IP-Adapter (Ye et al., 2023)。 RefGAP 针对上下文内设置进行优化，在该设置中，参考标记与内容标记在同一 softmax 函数内部相互竞争，其相对权重可以直接调整。

paragraphs.en: Training-free diffusion methods manipulate attention to control conditioning and source consistency ( Hertz et al., 2022 ; Cao et al., 2023 ) . Diptych Prompting ( Shin et al., 2025 ) enhances attention from queries in the generated panel to keys in the reference panel. FreeCustom ( Ding et al., 2024 ) combines multi-reference self-attention with weighted concept masks to integrate and emphasize reference concepts for multi-concept composition. RefDrop ( Fan et al., 2024 ) controls consistency across generated images or video frames by mixing reference and self-attention outputs with a user-specified scalar shared across queries.
paragraphs.zh: 无需训练的扩散方法通过操控注意力来控制条件约束和来源一致性（Hertz 等，2022；Cao 等，2023）。 Diptych Prompting（Shin 等，2025）增强了生成面板中的查询对参考面板中键的注意力。 FreeCustom（Ding 等，2024）将多参考自注意力与加权概念掩码相结合，以整合并强调参考概念，从而实现多概念组合。 RefDrop（Fan 等，2024）通过用用户指定的、在所有查询中共享的标量混合参考注意力和自注意力输出，来控制生成图像或视频帧之间的一致性。

paragraphs.en: These methods control reference influence through fixed or user-specified coefficients selected for a particular model or task. FreeCustom and RefDrop primarily target generation or consistency, without defining a region to preserve in an existing source image. Diptych also supports subject-driven editing through an edit mask, but its reference-attention boost remains uniform across queries in the edited panel. GRAG ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and DCAG ( Li, 2026 ) provide separate representation-level controls for editing strength through externally selected coefficients.

paragraphs.en: RefGAP determines logit-offset magnitudes online from reference attention measured separately for edit and keep queries. Positive offsets enhance reference attention in edit regions, while negative offsets suppress it in keep regions. After a single calibration, the same coefficients transfer to held-out approaches and additional tasks without further manual tuning.
paragraphs.zh: RefGAP 通过为编辑查询和保留查询分别测量的参考注意力，在线确定逻辑特偏移量的大小。 正偏移量会增强编辑区域中的参考注意力，而负偏移量则会抑制保留区域中的参考注意力。 经过一次校准后，相同的系数可以直接迁移到预留的方法和额外任务中，无需进一步的手动调整。

At each attention layer and denoising step, it measures reference-attention mass in both regions ( section 3.2 ) to determine reference-logit shifts ( section 3.3 ), applied according to a layer-selection rule ( section 3.4 ). Figure 1 summarizes this inference-time pipeline, which requires no weight updates.

paragraphs.en: To control reference-attention allocation, RefGAP adds a shared offset to the reference-key logits for each query group. This changes the total attention assigned to the reference while preserving the relative attention weights within each key group. The offset is positive for edit queries and negative for keep queries; its magnitude adapts to the corresponding measured reference mass.
paragraphs.zh: 为了控制参考注意力分配，RefGAP 为每个查询组的参考-键 logits 添加一个共享偏移量。 这改变了分配给参考的总注意力，同时保留了每个键组内相对注意力权重不变。 该偏移量对编辑查询为正，对保留查询为负；其大小会根据相应的测量参考质量进行调整。

paragraphs.en: For edit queries, lower reference mass yields a larger positive offset, strengthening reference attention. For keep queries, we use a heuristic negative offset whose magnitude decreases as reference mass increases. This design aims to accommodate potentially necessary changes beyond the mask, such as hair extending past its boundary; reference mass alone does not distinguish these changes from unwanted leakage.
paragraphs.zh: 对于编辑查询，较低的参考质量会产生更大的正向偏移，从而增强参考注意力。 对于保留查询，我们使用一种启发式的负向偏移，其大小会随着参考质量的增加而减小。 这种设计旨在容纳掩码之外可能必要的变化，例如头发延伸至其边界之外；仅凭参考质量无法将这些变化与不希望出现的溢出区分开来。

paragraphs.en: We derive the layer-selection rule from two recurring patterns in the reference-attention profiles of the four development approaches. Figure 2 shows profiles and selected layers for seven approaches. First, some approaches exhibit clear edit-keep separation: ρ ¯ edit ( ℓ ) \bar{\rho}_{\mathrm{edit}}^{(\ell)} dominates ρ ¯ keep ( ℓ ) \bar{\rho}_{\mathrm{keep}}^{(\ell)} within a localized layer band, typically in the network’s latter half, as in FLUX.2-klein ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) . Second, some assign little reference mass to edit queries across many layers, with ρ ¯ edit ( ℓ ) \bar{\rho}_{\mathrm{edit}}^{(\ell)} remaining around 10 − 2 10^{-2} , as in LoomVideo ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . The first pattern suggests a selective reference-reading band; the second indicates a risk of accumulating large corrections when intervening throughout the network.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从四种开发方法在参考注意力分布中反复出现的两种模式，推导出层选择规则。 图 2 展示了七种方法的分布曲线和所选层。 首先，某些方法表现出明显的“编辑-保留”分离：在某个局部化的层带内（通常位于网络的后半部分），ρ ¯ edit ( ℓ ) \bar{\rho}_{\mathrm{edit}}^{(\ell)} 的值会主导 ρ ¯ keep ( ℓ ) \bar{\rho}_{\mathrm{keep}}^{(\ell)} ，例如 FLUX.2-klein（Black Forest Labs，2025）。 其次，某些方法在许多层中为编辑查询分配的参考质量很少，此时 ρ ¯ edit ( ℓ ) \bar{\rho}_{\mathrm{edit}}^{(\ell)} 的值会保持在 10 − 2 10^{-2} 左右，例如 LoomVideo（Wu 等人，2026）。 第一种模式表明存在一个选择性的参考读取带；第二种模式则提示，如果在整个网络中进行干预，可能会积累大量修正。

paragraphs.en: Our primary evaluation focuses on head and face swapping. Head swapping uses the 1,040 test clips of HeadSwapBench ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , and face swapping uses the 1,000 official target-source pairs from the FaceSwap subset of FaceForensics++ ( Rossler et al., 2019 ) .

paragraphs.en: We further evaluate transfer beyond identity editing through virtual try-on and background replacement. Across all four tasks, video approaches process video clips, while image approaches edit the middle frame of each clip.

paragraphs.en: The all-step default prioritizes reference identity and can compromise pose and expression preservation. Delaying correction can mitigate these costs: on JoyAI-Video-Edit and FLUX.2-klein, skipping the first correction step substantially reduces keypoint error while retaining identity improvements over the base. paragraphs.en: We introduce RefGAP, a training-free method that uses measured reference-attention mass to dynamically strengthen reference influence in edit regions and suppress it in keep regions. With two coefficients calibrated on four development approaches and a shared layer-selection rule, RefGAP improves identity fidelity in head and face swapping across seven approaches, including three held-out ones. It achieves a fidelity-preservation trade-off comparable to approach-specific constant edit-side biases without per-approach strength sweeps. Transfer without task-specific retuning yields positive fidelity gains in virtual try-on but mixed results in background replacement. Together, these results support measured attention as a practical signal for controlling reference influence, while leaving attribute preservation and reliable cross-task transfer as directions for further work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 RefGAP，这是一种无需训练的方法，它利用测量得到的参考注意力质量，在编辑区域动态增强参考影响，并在保留区域抑制这种影响。 通过在四种开发方法上校准两个系数并采用共享的层选择规则，RefGAP 在七种方法（包括三种预留方法）中提升了头部和面部替换的身份保真度。 它实现了与特定方法恒定编辑侧偏置相当的保真度保持权衡，而无需针对每种方法单独调整强度。 无需任务特定的重新调整即可实现迁移，这在虚拟试穿中带来了积极的保真度提升，但在背景替换中的结果则好坏参半。 综合来看，这些结果表明测量得到的注意力是一种控制参考影响的实用信号，同时属性保持和可靠的跨任务迁移仍为后续研究的方向。

paragraphs.en: This work studies reference-guided visual editing, including head and face swapping, which can be misused to fabricate media of real individuals. All images and videos used in our evaluation are drawn from public benchmarks (HeadSwapBench, FaceForensics++, ViViD, VITON-HD, and SUN397). We release no new identity data and neither train nor release a new model; our method is an inference-time modification of publicly released editors.

paragraphs.en: Unless otherwise specified in ablations or diagnostic experiments, we use eq. 5 with ( γ edit , γ keep ) = ( 0.6 , 0.8 ) (\gamma_{\mathrm{edit}},\gamma_{\mathrm{keep}})=(0.6,0.8) . Using zero-based indices, correction is applied to layers 15–29 on LoomVideo and VACE, and 12–24 on FLUX.2-klein (25 layers). All layers are corrected on JoyAI-Video-Edit (40), FLUX.2-klein-base (25), Qwen-Image-Edit (60) and OmniGen2 (32). paragraphs.en: While the main paper evaluates general-purpose editors, we further apply RefGAP to a task-specific fine-tuned model. We evaluate DirectSwap ( Wang et al., 2025 ) in its released inference pipeline, including its attention-based background compositing. For this mask-free model, we define edit queries from the reference-attention mass of the first denoising step, averaged over all attention heads: in each of layers 8–26 (zero-based), a query casts a vote if its mass lies above the 0.7 quantile of its latent frame, and it is an edit query if more than 20% of these layers vote for it. These are the defaults of DirectSwap’s released background-compositing mask, so RefGAP adds no threshold of its own. The first step runs unmodified; the region is then fixed, and RefGAP acts on layers 15–29 for the remaining 29 of 30 sampling steps.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然主论文评估的是通用编辑器，但我们进一步将 RefGAP 应用于一个针对特定任务进行微调的模型。 我们在其发布的推理流程中评估了 DirectSwap（Wang 等人，2025），包括其基于注意力的背景合成机制。 对于这个无需掩码的模型，我们从第一步去噪过程中参考注意力质量中所有注意力头的平均值定义编辑查询：在第 8 至第 26 层（零基索引）的每一层中，如果某一层的质量高于其潜在帧的 0.7 分位数，则它投出赞成票；若超过 20% 的层对其投出赞成票，则它被视为编辑查询。 这些是 DirectSwap 发布的背景合成掩码的默认设置，因此 RefGAP 并未添加任何自身的阈值。 第一步未经修改地执行；随后该区域被固定，RefGAP 则在剩余的 30 次采样步骤中作用于第 15 至第 29 层。

paragraphs.en: To measure what the screening leaves out, we repeated the protocol on a form built without it: two items per approach and task drawn at random from each evaluation set ( 56 56 items, VACE background replacement included), plus two attention checks and two A/B-swapped repeats, answered by five raters. All five passed both checks, agreed with one another on 95 95 – 99 % 99\% of answers, and repeated their own judgment on 87 % 87\% of the swapped repeats. For reference fidelity, 27.9 % 27.9\% of judgments favored RefGAP, 3.6 % 3.6\% favored the base, and 68.6 % 68.6\% were ties, giving RefGAP an 88.6 % 88.6\% share among decided judgments. For visual quality, 92.1 % 92.1\% were ties, while all 22 22 decided judgments favored the base. Full results are reported in table 15 .

paragraphs.en: The 22 base-favoring quality judgments are concentrated in five items, rather than 22 distinct examples. paragraphs.en: In head swapping, keypoint degradation is concentrated in JoyAI-Video-Edit, FLUX.2-klein, and FLUX.2-klein-base, whereas face-swap keypoint error increases on most approaches. This difference partly reflects the face-swap evaluation protocol, in which the output is compared with the input geometry while being encouraged to adopt the reference identity. We first disentangle this identity-geometry confound and show that the remaining keypoint and expression costs are concentrated in the same three approaches as in head swapping. We then examine whether delaying the attention correction reduces these costs. Finally, we analyze the background-replacement failure of Qwen-Image-Edit and the occasional blurred-face failures of OmniGen2.
paragraphs.zh: 在头部替换任务中，关键点退化主要集中在 JoyAI-Video-Edit、FLUX.2-klein 和 FLUX.2-klein-base 上，而面部替换的关键点错误则在大多数方法中有所增加。 这种差异部分反映了面部替换的评估协议：在该协议中，输出结果会与输入几何结构进行比较，同时被鼓励采用参考身份特征。 我们首先解除了身份与几何结构之间的混淆，并证明剩余的关键点和表情成本主要集中在与头部替换任务相同的三种方法中。 接着，我们研究了延迟注意力校正是否能降低这些成本。 最后，我们分析了 Qwen-Image-Edit 的背景替换失败问题以及 OmniGen2 偶尔出现的面部模糊失败情况。

paragraphs.en: FF++ does not provide ground-truth edited frames, so face-swap keypoints are evaluated against the driving input rather than the reference identity. Although the landmarks are scale-normalized, they remain sensitive to identity-specific face shape. Consequently, successful identity transfer can increase keypoint error even when the input pose is preserved.
paragraphs.zh: FF++ 不提供经过人工修正的真实帧，因此人脸交换的关键点需要与驱动输入进行比对，而非参考身份。 尽管这些地标点已经进行了尺度归一化，但它们仍然对特定身份的人脸形状较为敏感。 因此，即使输入姿态得以保留，成功实现身份转换仍可能导致关键点误差增大。
